name: icd10cm-coding
title: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code set files
summary: Read the published ICD-10-CM files exactly: codes valid for submission and headers, how codes are built, the hierarchy, what changed between two annual releases, and whether the files agree with each other.
description: Each task gives the AI lines of the real ICD-10-CM files as the US government publishes them, with the publisher's own descriptions of their layout. It asks for exact answers, such as whether a code is valid for submission, how many codes sit under a header, which codes a release added or reworded, or where two files disagree. No task asks the AI to code a clinical record or apply a coding guideline. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Code lookup
families.what: Whether a code is valid for submission, in which release, and which code a long description belongs to.

families.name: Valid codes and headers
families.what: Codes valid for submission told apart from headers, by chapter, block and category.

families.name: Code structure
families.what: Code length, the placeholder X, 7th characters and where the decimal point goes.

families.name: Hierarchy
families.what: Parents, categories and the valid codes under a header, followed from the codes themselves.

families.name: Code ranges
families.what: Which codes fall in a range by the order file's order numbers, including ranges that end on a header.

families.name: Laterality and encounter
families.what: Right and left pairs, laterality wording and the encounter types that 7th characters give.

families.name: Descriptions
families.what: Short and long descriptions, and how much the short ones abbreviate.

families.name: Release changes
families.what: Codes added, removed and reworded between two annual releases, without being misled by renumbering.

families.name: Addenda
families.what: The publisher's change lists read correctly and checked against the files they describe.

families.name: File consistency
families.what: Whether the tabular list, the order file and the addenda agree, without raising false alarms.
